name: Siddhant Karkare
head: Client Partner - Global Capability Centers (GCC), Kyndryl (ex-Birlasoft BD)
text: Client Partner - Global Capability Centers (GCC), Kyndryl (ex-Birlasoft BD)

strengths: His current role is GCC client partner, which matches the IGS brief
Was BD and account manager at Birlasoft selling engineering and IT applications services; describes himself as a hunter across automotive, life sciences and retail
gaps: Kyndryl sells infrastructure services, and he has no testing (QE) sales track record
Has done presales and demand generation alongside sales, so check how much of his revenue was won from new logos
screen.next: Strong outreach target. Lead with the GCC new-logo mandate and the chance to move from infrastructure into QE and AI engineering.

name: Mahima Sudhakaran
head: AVP Sales, Persistent Systems (ex-Global Client Partner, Wipro)
text: AVP Sales, Persistent Systems (ex-Global Client Partner, Wipro)

strengths: At Wipro she was global client partner for a $20M+ auto/manufacturing portfolio delivered by 1,000+ people
Her service mix included quality engineering, plus CXO relationships
gaps: Probably above the 8-15 year band, and AVP level may be too senior for the role
Background is growing large existing accounts more than winning new ones
screen.next: Gauge her appetite for a hands-on new-logo role. She is also a good source of referrals into her client-partner network.

strengths: Has been in sales at Persistent for 14 years, so he knows digital engineering services
gaps: Profile has almost no detail: territory, deals and hunting record are all unknown
Being with one employer for 14 years suggests he may not want to move
screen.next: Message him to ask his territory and whether he sells new logos into the US/EU

name: Arjun Mahajan
head: Senior Business Development Executive, Cybage Software
text: Senior Business Development Executive, Cybage Software

strengths: Has 5 years of BD at Cybage, an outsourced product engineering firm
gaps: Under the 8-year minimum and still at executive level
No evidence of closing deals himself
screen.next: Keep on file for a junior hunter role
